sentences.text: Date : 19.10.2023 Heard Mr. N.J.Dutta, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. B.Sarma,
learned Addl. Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent No.1.

Mr. D Talukdar, learned Page No.#
2/2 counsel appears for the respondent No.2.

By this petition filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioner, namely, Md. Umar Ali @ Oumar Ali,
has prayed for granting pre-arrest bail, apprehending arrest in connection with Mayong P.S. Case No. 93/2023 registered u/s 4/6 of the POCSO Act.
The case diary, as called for, is placed before this Court.

Mr. N.J.Dutta, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, citing an order, dated 13.09.2023,
passed by a single Judge of Hon'ble Bombay High Court, submits that the instant pre-arrest bail application is sustainable in law.

Per contra, however, Mr. B Sarma, learned Addl.P.P. submits that in view of the statutory provision having grant of pre-arrest bail in offence covering Section 376 AB of the IPC under Section 438(4)
CrPC, the instant pre-arrest bail application is not maintainable.
On hearing of both sides, this Court finds it expedient for a detail hearing on the matter.
List in the 3rd Week of November, 2023.
Case diary be returned for re-submission updated.
